sloka: निर्गच्छति महाबाहौ रामे पौरजनाश्रुभिः ।पतितैरभ्यवहितम् प्रशशाम महीरजः ॥२-४०-३३॥
transliteration: nirgacchati mahābāhau rāme paurajanāśrubhiḥ ।patitairabhyavahitam praśaśāma mahīrajaḥ ॥2-40-33॥

translations.english: As the mightyarmed Rama was going away, the dust raised from the earth subsided with the tears falling from the citizens' (eyes).
